source_invariants.name: original full learned forward and cost
source_invariants.explanation: begin and latency match v2 bytes exactly. k is original decoded address count after the original decoder cap; it is never replaced by final filtered/fixed payload count.

source_invariants.name: completion-only h/c publish; serial initiation
source_invariants.explanation: Exactly one active result. Publish h/c on now>=due before starting next queued event. Input queue can begin next event at that same completion cycle, giving saturated II=service.

source_invariants.name: fixed payload after fullforward
source_invariants.explanation: All decoder computations and scheduled service are retained; append_result alone chooses learned vs one+2 gated by result.emit. Raw result/K/delta diagnostics remain available.

source_invariants.name: current filter after output queue before credits
source_invariants.explanation: Engine pops output and calls cache prefetch_line; common gate suppresses current-line before page/budget accounting. The output_next cycle still advances for suppressed requests; this intervention does not reclaim serial compute or output-drain cycles.

source_invariants.name: service without callbacks
source_invariants.explanation: Outer CPU cycle loop calls dynamic602_service, including stalls and absence of new eligible LOAD callbacks.

formula.zero_cost: M=0 gives0 service; no online weight training
formula.k: original actually decoded learned k after cap32, before payload change/filter
